name: aiec-console
description: AIEC Console — a standalone web UI where users manage their ServiceNow instance through a user-scoped AI agent

scripts.db:migrate: node -e "import('./server/env.js').then(()=>import('./server/db.js')).then(async m=>{console.log('applied', await m.migrate()); await m.close();})"
scripts.check: for f in server/*.js public/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done
